plan.description: Freeze and hash organism, namespace, selection, directional rules, size bounds, BH alpha and overlap limit before collection admission.
Admit unique tested genes, selected lists and the frozen versioned local collection.
Compute exact one-sided hypergeometric tails and BH across every tested set/list pair; retain untested sets.
Compute pairwise Jaccard and report every above-limit connected component once.
Register ordinary artifacts and separate claims for coordinator-owned rigor and independent review.
